entry.title: Portugal number range PR missing in digital signature configuration
entry.content:
Hi SAP Community,

I am configuring SD billing for Portugal in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, following this SAP Help documentation.

The documentation instructs me to create a number range. However, I cannot find a step explaining how to make this number range available in Record Number Ranges for Digital Signature of Billing Documents (SD).

Number ranges created

I created the internal number range intervals PR for Portuguese invoices and PG for Portuguese credit memos under object RV_BELEG.

Additional configuration

The linked instructions do not mention creating a custom routine. Nevertheless, I additionally configured flexible billing document numbering to determine the Portuguese number range as follows:

Tax Departure Country Billing Type Number Range Interval

PTF2PR
PTG2PG

The formula is Z_BILL_PT, with usage B01 and usage task SET_NUMBER_RANGE. The number range prefix is blank.

I registered routine 3000004 for SD_BIL_FLEX_NUMBERING and assigned enhancement identifier Z_BILL_PT.

 

I then assigned routine 3000004 to billing type F2. The standard number range shown for F2 remains 19.

 

Actual result and question

In Record Number Ranges for Digital Signature of Billing Documents (SD), I expected the newly created interval PR to be available.

Instead, the value help shows 19 for billing type F2, and I cannot find PR.

Could someone clarify the correct configuration sequence specifically for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition?

  1. How should a newly created number range such as PR become available in this configuration activity?

  2. Is a custom routine actually required? The linked documentation does not mention this step.

  3. Should I select 19 / F2, while the routine determines PR at runtime? If so, how is the digital signature and series configuration associated with the actual interval PR?

  4. Or is there another required assignment that I have missed?

I would appreciate help understanding the missing connection between creating the number range and configuring it for Portuguese digital signatures.

Thank you for your help!

Kind regards,
David

entry.title: How to Exclude a condition type from Accounting in Intercompany Billing?
entry.content:
Hi Experts,

I have a requirement in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud to exclude condition type ZTPR from accounting and consider only the preceding condition types PCIP and ZI02 for accounting.

I configured the pricing procedure as follows:

  • Marked ZTPR as statistical.
  • Removed the account key from ZTPR.
  • Assigned account keys to PCIP and ZI02.

However, during Intercompany Billing, ZTPR is active and the statistical indicator is not set in the billing document. Because of this, the preceding conditions PCIP and ZI02 become inactive and are not considered for accounting.

I tested the same pricing procedure in a normal sales and billing process, where it works as expected. ZTPR remains statistical and the other conditions remain active.

The issue occurs only during the IC billing process.

My expected accounting behavior is:

  • PCIP → Accounting relevant
  • ZI02 → Accounting relevant
  • ZTPR → Not accounting relevant
At the same time, ZTPR is used in another pricing procedure, so any proposed solution should not impact its existing behavior in that sales process.

Could you please help clarify the following?

  1. Is this the standard behavior for intercompany billing in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud?
  2. Why is the statistical indicator maintained for ZTPR not reflected in the IC billing document?
  3. Is there any standard configuration or supported approach to prevent ZTPR from being relevant for accounting while keeping PCIP and ZI02 active and relevant for accounting?
  4. Is there any specific restriction related to statistical conditions in the intercompany pricing procedure that needs to be considered?

I have attached the pricing procedure screenshot for reference.

Thanks in advance for your support.
